concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create one premium standalone logo symbol for Viral4All Ads, a web app for managing Meta advertising campaigns through AI assistants with owner approval. Output a square 1024x1024 transparent PNG, a single centered symbol, optical footprint approximately 66% of the square, generous safe margins. Style: precise flat vector-like brand identity, bold compact silhouette, smooth flawless edges, highly legible at 24 pixels, no thin strokes. Color: rich solid violet #7C3AED, optional very small accent #A78BFA only where specified. No background, no square tile, no wordmark, no text labels, no captions, no numbers, no mockup, no sheet, no shadows, no gradients, no spheres, no glossy 3D, no watermarks. The output is the actual reusable logo asset, not a presentation.
Concept V4 RISE: a distinctive abstract V monogram formed from two solid rising wings. The left is a short bold diagonal descending into a clean bottom vertex; the right is a longer confident diagonal rising to the upper right with one stepped notch, subtly suggesting an upward arrow and the geometry of the number four in negative space. Refined modern identity, coherent single-piece visual shape, slightly rounded corners, dynamic but balanced. One violet color. Avoid a generic check mark: both wings wide and a subtle cut in the right wing gives the monogram originality.

Concept BROADCAST: an ultra-reduced advertising megaphone symbol made from a compact violet trapezoidal horn with one integrated short handle, facing upper right, and two substantial separated lavender radiating wedges. Use a distinctive geometric arrangement with rounded joins, silhouette as clear as a top-tier app icon. Four solid purposeful shapes at most, plenty of space between. The signal wedges must be thick enough to survive favicon size. Emphasis on reach, amplification, and advertising.

Concept SIGNAL: a bold iconic growth waveform that reads as an abstract V. Four thick vertical capsules with angled lower terminals create a rising staircase from a short central low point to a taller right-hand bar, unified visual rhythm. Simple memorable asymmetric silhouette, expressive negative space, violet only. Precisely balanced widths and gaps; minimal 1970s modernist identity translated to contemporary software. The shape should communicate measured campaign growth and analytics, never resemble a generic equalizer square.

Concept APERTURE: a strong circular aperture made of exactly four substantial violet curved blades around a crisp triangular negative-space center pointing up. The aperture implies campaign focus, controlled reach, and creative intelligence. No camera body or lens realism, just a sophisticated geometric emblem. Wide gaps between the four blades, flat violet only, rotational balance with a subtly upward visual direction. Thick shapes, no fine outlines.
